newsitem.title: USA: Ag Services arranges new securitization.
newsitem.headline: Ag Services arranges new securitization.

text.p: Ag Services of America Inc said Wednesday it completed an asset-backed securitization program for a maxmimum of up to $135 million that replaces its $100 million line of credit from the previous year.
The program is a five-year facility structured and guaranteed by Capital Markets Assurance Corp.

Under terms of the facility, Ag Services sells and may continue to sell or contribute certain notes receivable to Ag Acceptance Corp, a newly formed, wholly owned special-purpose subsidiary of the company.
Ag Acceptance pledges its interest in these notes receivable to a commercial-paper market conduit entity and incurs interest at variable rates in the commercial paper market.
The company estimates it will realize an interest rate reduction of as much as 100 basis points on outstanding borrowings under the new facility.
Ag Services supplies seed, fertilizer and agricultural chemicals as well as crop insurance and cash advances for land rent and fuel to farmers.
